Decision requested
Approve a lean SNS operating model with conditional affiliate offer retention.

Reduce SNS-specific overhead and retire nonviable funnels, while preserving Moringa, Berberine, and Turmeric as candidates for controlled white-hat e-commerce affiliate tests. Retain shared WBM developers and move customer support to Rose by December 1, 2026. Keep or close each offer based on actual contribution after affiliate commissions, product costs, refunds, and incremental overhead.

No developer terminations are proposed. AI is an assistive tool, not a budgeted substitute for engineering, QA, integrations or reporting.

What changes, what stays

What we scale back

New speculative SNS builds, marginal or unprofitable funnels, redundant software, agency-based customer service, and avoidable overhead. Retire products only after open-order, refund, subscription, inventory, and compliance obligations are mapped.

Do not prematurely deactivate Moringa, Berberine, or Turmeric fulfillment or live funnels while controlled affiliate testing is evaluated.

What stays

Moringa, Berberine, and Turmeric as conditional affiliate-test candidates; Complete Thyroid as an early-stage prospect pending confirmation; shared developers for WBM-wide needs; email marketing as a separate operation; coaching and consulting; affiliate marketing; and Amazon client joint-venture storefronts.

Amazon JV model is a partner storefront / software-and-services model, not the same SNS-owned inventory model. Confirm agreement-specific obligations.

Financial evidence: SNS DTC only

Cash received and costs recorded in the SNS QuickBooks P&L. The entire EMAIL section is excluded. Shared WBM development payroll is outside this SNS-specific assessment and is not treated as shutdown savings.

Post-handoff savings and safeguards

HelpGrid estimated agency spend: $1,496/month. Proposed ongoing Help Scout: 2 paid users (Cody and Rose), estimated $90/month versus approximately $162/month currently. Exact plan, add-ons, phone service, and staffing time must be verified.

Do not remove HelpGrid seats Eden and Jess until ticket ownership, workflows, export needs, and contract notice are complete. Preserve existing support number where possible; implement voicemail-to-ticket handling with a tested callback exception process.

Agency noticeContract reportedly requires 30 days. Confirm delivery, effective termination date, and any overlap billing before treating Dec 1 as a final cancellation date.

90-day restructuring and affiliate timeline

Three 30-day phases, each closed by the decision gates on the right.

Days 1–30 · Oct 27–Nov 25Cut unnecessary spend + qualify affiliatesFreeze new speculative SNS builds. Audit recurring subscriptions and true avoidable costs. Confirm affiliate names, traffic method, terms and realistic launch dates. Validate per-order Moringa/Berberine/Turmeric economics; clarify whether Complete Thyroid interest advances to an actionable test and inventory supply; review claims and compliance before any traffic.
Days 31–60 · Nov 26–Dec 25Support cutover + controlled offer testsComplete HelpGrid-to-Rose transition by Dec 1, then remove unneeded Help Scout seats. Run only approved affiliate tests within inventory, spend and refund safeguards. Monitor settled proceeds, actual orders, disputes and fulfillment.
Days 61–90 · Dec 26–Jan 25Keep / pause / retire offer by offerCompare verified cash contribution against incremental operating burden; keep offers that pass agreed economics, retire others with orderly customer and inventory handling. Keep shared development resources assigned to other WBM priorities.

Affiliate opportunity: Moringa, Berberine, Turmeric

New whale affiliates have expressed interest in white-hat e-commerce Moringa, Berberine, and Turmeric offers, with possible interest in Complete Thyroid. No launches or profits are presumed. Qualify each partner and test offers independently, then evaluate settled cash contribution.

Affiliate contribution scenario

Scenario planning only. These are editable assumptions, not current affiliate commitments, validated funnel margins, or forecasts. Enter commissions, refunds and fulfillment costs rather than inferring them from gross sales.

Contribution per order
—
after affiliate payout, fulfillment and expected reductions
30-day contribution
—
after incremental overhead; excludes shared overhead and working capital
Minimum keep rule: Verify actual incremental contribution using BuyGoods settlement data and direct costs, then apply a management-approved margin and volume threshold. Do not mistake gross sales for cash received or affiliate interest for proven profit.

Avoidable-cost model

Test savings from the HelpGrid-to-Rose transition and other overhead cuts, even if Moringa, Berberine, or Turmeric stay live. Figures are editable assumptions, not automatically realizable savings. Developer salaries are retained.

Monthly fixed-cost reduction
—
independent of offer sales; excludes phone/VA amounts not entered
Annualized, less one-time costs
—
steady-state scenario, not first-year actual cash savings
Decision test: Ongoing contribution from retained offers + verified fixed costs avoided − incremental support/phone/offer costs − transition charges. Do not count retained developer payroll as savings.

WBM portfolio and the boundary of this decision

Retained businesses

Amazon JV storefronts: Client-partner supplement commerce supported by software, reporting and execution rather than SNS-owned products.

Affiliate marketing: Commission-driven business with lower direct fulfillment burden.

Coaching / consulting: Service revenue dependent on Cody's own capacity.

Analyze independently

Email marketing: Separate operating and financial decision. Excluded from this SNS profitability calculation; any future offer dependency review belongs in its own workstream.

Developers: Centralize budget and project prioritization for all retained business lines.
